## Review checklist

- [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits and are atomic.
- [ ] `make lint` passes.
- [ ] `make test` passes; new behavior is tested.
- [ ] Types + Google-style docstrings on public API.
- [ ] No hardcoded paths or hyperparameters.
- [ ] README / CONTRIBUTING updated if behavior changed.
- [ ] `.env` not staged.
